title: Detect zero exactly and bound the exact rational permanent height
statement: For A_ij=p_ij/q_ij nonnegative with complete integer bit length B_A, the permanent is zero exactly when the positive support graph has no perfect matching. Let D=product_all q_ij and P=D per(A); then P is an integer, D<2^B_A, and 0<=P<n!*2^B_A. Thus exact P/D numerator/denominator have O(B_A+n log(n+1)) bits even without reduced input fractions.
